summary: Frontend-only verification of SessionShareCard polish (iter 69): Download button now always renders alongside Share (when supported), new helper tip line, and iOS-Safari download opens image in new tab. Reproduced full flow with admin login → 1-min Smart-Fade session → wellness-checkin-share → session-share-card. All 7 test scenarios in the review request PASS.
test_scenarios_verified: Admin login → dashboard loaded, play-pause-button visible (PASS)
Duration slider set to 1, play-pause tapped, Smart-Fade completion observed at ~60s → wellness-checkin-share button appeared (PASS)
Headless Chromium (no canShare with files): session-share-share-btn=0, session-share-download-btn=1 labelled 'Download card' — Download always renders as required (PASS)
session-share-tip element renders with exact text: 'Tip: for Instagram or TikTok, save the card and upload from your camera roll.' (PASS)
Clicking session-share-download-btn fires a real download event with filename 'solarisound-432hz.png' matching solarisound-<hz>.png pattern (PASS)
iOS-Safari fallback: after CDP UA override to iPhone Safari, clicking Download opens a NEW TAB with a blob: URL and does NOT fire a download event (correct long-press-to-Save-to-Photos path) (PASS)
session-share-preview src is data:image/png with length 1,319,526 bytes (>>5000) confirming canvas render (PASS)
Dismiss via X close (session-share-close), Maybe later (session-share-dismiss), and backdrop click on session-share-card outer div all close overlay (PASS)
Standalone 528Hz test canvas render produces valid data:image/png URL of length 67,902 bytes (>5000) (PASS)
critical_code_review_comments: SessionShareCard.jsx: iOS detection uses both /iPad|iPhone|iPod/ UA test and MacIntel+maxTouchPoints>1 heuristic for iPadOS — correct approach.
triggerDownload iOS branch: window.open(url,'_blank') with fallback to window.location.href when popup is blocked — good defensive coding. Revoke delayed 60s to keep the new tab's blob alive.
canNativeShare probe uses a 1-byte File, so the button visibility decision is stable and cheap. The Download button now renders unconditionally in a separate block — matches the design brief.

Tip line uses text-[10.5px] which is unusually small but readable at desktop widths; contrast (#8A9A92 on #0B1814) is acceptable but borderline for WCAG AA at that size. Consider bumping to 11px or lightening color slightly on mobile if user feedback indicates readability issues.
Duplicated Tailwind class strings between the two buttons could be extracted to a variable, but as-is readable and scoped to this file. Non-blocking.
No changes needed to WellnessCheckinCard.jsx or Dashboard.jsx — wiring preserved from iter 68.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Same trigger recipe as iter 68: duration-slider=1 → play-pause-button → wait ~60-70s for wellness-checkin-share. In headless Chromium canNativeShare is false so only Download button renders (label 'Download card'); when canNativeShare is true (real mobile Safari/Chrome), BOTH Share and Download render (Download label becomes 'Save to photos'). iOS UA override via CDP Emulation.setUserAgentOverride triggers the new-tab path in triggerDownload (no <a download> event fires).
